goal: Prevent nodes from disconnecting well-behaved peers on slow connections during block download
Avoids spurious ping timeouts when large block transfers delay pong responses
agreement: Substantive support with prior edge-case timeout objections resolved
Verified by testing block downloads with bandwidth throttling in regtest (AndreaDiazCorreia)
Concept approval without full review (l0rinc, danielabrozzoni)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes an edge-case liveness bug where slow connections cause spurious peer disconnects
Constrained bandwidth peers benefit during initial sync, but the fix is reasonably deferrable
